# XDP LTD

XDP LTD is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. XDP is a leading parcel and freight network, offering expert delivery services nationwide. With over 25 years of experience within the freight and logistics industry, XDP is a leading parcel and freight network, offering expert delivery services nationwide. XDP LTD employs 263 people (+4.4% YoY, +11 people), founded in 1995. Headquartered in Curdworth, England, United Kingdom, with offices in Tamworth and Minworth. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Nepal.

## About

XDP was formed in 1995 and has since grown to be the largest privately owned parcel and freight network in the UK. Specialising in irregular dimension and weight freight, we are constantly building on our reputation for reliability and quality of service.

We understand how important the final mile of your delivery is, that’s why we are there every step of the way. With an extensive national team covering our final-mile delivery depots, alongside a nationwide fleet of delivery partners, our reputation for customer focused logistics continues to go from strength to strength. 

Through offering a variety of bespoke delivery service packages, ranging from 1 and 2Man services, through to Storage and Distribution offerings, we are the B2C carrier of choice for large and non-standard freight.

# XDP Logistics Group

XDP Logistics Group is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. XDP Logistics Group is a well-established end-to-end logistics service provider, serving small, medium, and large organizations with equal amounts of dedication. They offer a wide array of services including transportation, warehousing and distribution solutions, freight clearing and forwarding, logistics outsourcing, consulting and mentoring. XDP Logistics Group employs 14 people (+16.7% YoY, +2 people), founded in 2007. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom and South Africa.

## About

XDP Logistics Group is a well -established End-to-End Logistics Service Provider, serving small, medium and large organizations with equal amounts of dedication.

Our flexibility as an organization allows us to provide a wide array of services, including transportation, warehousing and distribution solutions, freight clearing and forwarding, logistics outsourcing, consulting and mentoring, least-cost routing and various other services.

Whether you are “new at this”, a fledgling importer or exporter or an established player, you will find that XDP Logistics Group is the one for you!
